# Consent portal

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P3 · Act as the user](../README.md#phase-3--act-as-the-user) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:consent-portal` · **Epic:** — · **Tickets:** 4 (2S 2M)

A small employee-facing UI on the CP at /portal lists connected accounts, lets the user connect or revoke a provider and shows which agents used each grant recently. It also hosts the landing page for a pending authorization created by a JIT 403.

## How we build it

- Embedded single HTML page (go:embed, same pattern as internal/dashboard/index.html) served at /portal; JSON API under /portal/api/* behind portal session + CSRF middleware.
- GET /portal/api/grants → [{provider, scopes, granted_at, last_used_at, recent_agents:[{agent, last_used_at, calls_7d}]}]; recent usage is a query on the CP analytics store filtered by user_sub and provider (no bodies).
- POST /portal/api/grants/{provider}/revoke → read token from secret backend, oauthbroker.Revoke, SecretStore.Delete, GrantStore.RevokeGrant, invalidate worker caches by bumping a per-user grant epoch carried in the policy wire, audit connect.revoked. Partial failure: vault delete still runs if provider revoke fails; failure is shown and audited.
- GET /portal/connect/{pending_id}: landing page showing agent, provider, capped scopes and the agent's message; Continue posts to /connect/start; if the pending belongs to a different sub, show an error and do not reveal details.

## Done when

An employee can see their connected accounts and recent agent usage, connect a new provider, revoke one so the next agent call returns authorization_required, and complete a pending authorization from the link an agent posted.

### 1/4 · W-P3-PORT-01

**Serve portal page and grants list API**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add internal/portal/index.html (embedded) and GET /portal/api/me and GET /portal/api/grants. Grants come from GrantStore.ListGrants(sub); recent_agents comes from a parameterized query over the CP analytics store on user_sub, provider and agent for the last 7 days. The page lists providers from the registry with Connect buttons for those not yet granted.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A user with a Google grant sees it with scopes and last_used_at
- [ ] recent_agents lists only agents that used this user's grant, never another user's
- [ ] The page renders at phone width without horizontal scroll

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-BRKR-04`](oauth-broker.md#45--w-p3-brkr-04) Implement /connect/callback and write tokens to secret backend; [`W-P3-PUL-02`](per-user-limits.md#25--w-p3-pul-02) Add user_sub, user_email and agent columns to analytics

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-PORT-02`](consent-portal.md#24--w-p3-port-02) Implement revoke: provider revoke, vault delete, worker invalidation

### 2/4 · W-P3-PORT-02

**Implement revoke: provider revoke, vault delete, worker invalidation**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add POST /portal/api/grants/{provider}/revoke calling a shared oauthbroker.RevokeUserGrant(ctx, sub, provider) that reads the token, calls Revoke, deletes warden/users/<sub>/<provider>, sets grants.revoked_at, and increments userGrantEpochs[sub] in the policy wire so workers drop cached access tokens for that (sub, provider) on the next poll. Steps continue on provider failure; the result reports each step. Audit connect.revoked.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] After revoke the secret key is absent and the fake provider saw a revoke call
- [ ] A worker with a cached access token returns authorization_required on the next request after policy poll
- [ ] Provider revoke failure still deletes the vault entry and returns a partial status

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-PORT-01`](consent-portal.md#14--w-p3-port-01) Serve portal page and grants list API; [`W-P3-BRKR-05`](oauth-broker.md#55--w-p3-brkr-05) Add provider revoke client for Google and GitHub; [`W-P3-PUS-03`](refresh-model.md#35--w-p3-pus-03) Implement UserTokenSource with cache, refresh and write-back

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-PORT-04`](consent-portal.md#44--w-p3-port-04) Write consent portal user and operator guide; [`W-P3-OFFB-01`](offboarding.md#14--w-p3-offb-01) Implement idempotent Offboard(sub, reason) operation

### 3/4 · W-P3-PORT-03

**Add pending authorization landing page**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue —

Add GET /portal/connect/{pending_id} (portal session required; redirect through login preserving the path). Render agent id, provider, capped scopes, the message and expiry; Continue goes to /connect/start?pending=<id>, Decline marks the pending denied. Expired or foreign pendings show a generic not-available page with no details.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Signed-out users are sent through Dex login and land back on the same pending page
- [ ] Decline sets status=denied and a status long-poll returns denied
- [ ] Another user's pending id shows the generic page

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-BRKR-03`](oauth-broker.md#35--w-p3-brkr-03) Implement /connect/start with PKCE and agent scope capping
